statements.reason: The context does not say annual inspections replace semiannual checks.
statements.statement: At an annual inspection, semiannual checks are not required.

evidence_quotes:
INTERVAL: Annually
ITEM NO.: 29
ITEM TO BE INSPECTED: Air-Intake
System
PROCEDURES: Test CDR valve (para. 3-9).
statements.reason: The annual air-intake procedure specifies this test.
statements.statement: Annual inspections include testing the CDR valve (para. 3-9).

evidence_quotes:
Wiping with a rag
is the only authorized method of
cleaning.
statements.reason: Wiping with a rag is the only authorized cleaning method.
statements.statement: The air-intake CDR valve must be cleaned by wiping with a rag.

evidence_quotes: Do not clean CDR valve with solvent.
statements.reason: The caution explicitly forbids solvent cleaning.
statements.statement: Cleaning the air-intake CDR valve with solvent is prohibited.

evidence_quotes:
Do not clean CDR valve with solvent.
This will damage the diaphragm in-
side the CDR valve.
statements.reason: The caution states that solvent cleaning damages the diaphragm.
statements.statement: Cleaning the air-intake CDR valve with solvent will damage the diaphragm inside the CDR valve.
